### Validation and limitations

Three screened development records were retrieved (3/3; **100% relative recall against this development set**). That is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity: no seed articles were supplied, no prior-review benchmark was identified, and no held-out set was available.

The Monte Carlo/simulation block was tested but left out to protect recall. It would reduce the result count from 5,069 to 943; none of the 30 sampled losses met eligibility, but only three known development records were available—below the skill’s threshold for safely adding the block. Screen simulation design, small-sample context, comparator, discipline, and peer-review status.

The cutoff is an **Entrez-entry date** bound; no publication-date limit was added. This is a PubMed-only draft, so coverage of social/behavioural methods may be incomplete. The PRESS-structured internal review passed, but the strategy still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
